title: FAQ
text: Japan spans long north-south east-west range. geographically literal map can make smaller islands difficult see. jpmap follows usmap idea using insets important regions remain visible ordinary plots. title: Okinawa and Ogasawara Insets
text: Use ogasawara = FALSE want Okinawa moved.  Use okinawa = FALSE want Ogasawara moved.
code: plot_jpmap(   "prefecture",   ogasawara = FALSE ) +   labs(title = "Okinawa inset only") +   theme(     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#001040")   ) plot_jpmap(   "prefecture",   okinawa = FALSE ) +   labs(title = "Ogasawara inset only") +   theme(     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#001040")   )

title: Okinawa and Ogasawara Insets
text: Use xlim ylim set longitude/latitude limits. can also set axis breaks labels. example keeps main islands Okinawa dropping Ogasawara inset.
code: plot_jpmap(   "prefecture",   ogasawara = FALSE,   xlim = c(122, 149),   ylim = c(28.5, 47),   x_breaks = seq(125, 145, 5),   y_breaks = seq(30, 45, 5),   x_labels = function(x) paste0(x, "\u00b0E"),   y_labels = function(y) paste0(y, "\u00b0N") ) +   labs(title = "Main islands with Okinawa inset") +   theme(     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#001040")   )

title: jpmap 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN submission. Added usmap-style API Japan maps: jp_map(), plot_jpmap(), jp_map_join(), plot_jpmap(), jpmap_transform(), jpmap_crs(). Added support prefecture municipal boundary layers. Added inset transformations controls Okinawa Ogasawara, including true-coordinate graticules inside inset boxes axis-limit controls. Added disputed-territory island/reef shapes controls territorial_disputes = FALSE. Added jp_map_leaflet() interactive web maps. Added sample GDP-per-capita U.S. military base datasets, plus focused vignettes using tidyverse-style examples native R pipe. Added pkgdown website Samurai Blue logo/theme.
